additional_info.subject: ID0375392-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / R5 170001806] Plc problem after firmware update CRM:00797001188
additional_info.body:
Hello Martin﻿,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Sominath
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R5 170001806
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
HxY9Wi
Problem Description
:
Sicharge_PLC_CPU_KF1"-Error-Flag after Update
Troubleshooting
:
Upon reviewing the logs, we found that the charger was rebooted by someone and is currently offline on SCB.
The recommended workaround is to avoid rebooting the charger before ES intervenes via SSH. Rebooting the charger may cause the PLC to stop, potentially leading to a 'Charger OFF + SCB Offline' situation. Please note that this issue occurs only on systems running version v5.0.19 that have both chargers and dispensers
.
Note: If your Regional Service team is able to visit the impacted charger, please follow these steps for further troubleshooting:
Do not reboot the charger.
While the SiC D Unit is still on, open the front door, locate KF1, and restart the PLC using the mode switch.
After restarting KF1 (PLC), reboot the SiC D unit either via SCB or the HMI.
Ensure that all error flags on SCB disappear after the reboot.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0375392
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sominath Nagalgaon
